besluite.fout: 'die plant of dier' points back to a plant the block body never mentions; the statement is a general one.
besluite.rede: The indefinite article makes the general statement read correctly without changing what it says, and the protected 'lyf' and 'eie' stay intact.
'hul' as a possessive is standard, natural Afrikaans, so the change is a lateral move.
'Ons kry baie fossiele van blare' is natural Afrikaans for 'there are many', and 'vind' narrows it to the act of discovering, so it is lateral at best.

besluite.fout: 'lyk na' sits beside 'lyk soos' in the contrast it sets up, and 'lyk na' can also read as 'seems to be'.
besluite.rede: Using 'lyk soos' in both halves of the contrast reads more clearly and keeps the meaning (resemble) the same.
